Confidence intervals for
squared semipartial correlation coefficients
and Cohen's f-squared
are generated using
the `SCorSqNB()` and `FSqNB()` functions from the `betaNB` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaNB: Example Using the BetaNB Function](example-beta-nb.html).


``` r
library(betaNB)
```




``` r
df <- betaNB::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Nonparametric Bootstrap


``` r
nb <- NB(object)
```

### Squared Semipartial Correlation Coefficients

The semipartial correlation is signed,
and its interval may contain zero.
`SCorSqNB()` returns the image of the signed interval under squaring.
It is not the interval of squared draws.


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>               est       lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.079919122 0.3124586
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.036027404 0.2247309
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.008510303 0.1390376
```


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "bca")
#>               est       lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.095726324 0.3477819
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.047620517 0.2565136
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.009949351 0.1457498
```

### Cohen's f-Squared


``` r
out <- FSqNB(nb, alpha = 0.05)
```

## Methods

### summary


``` r
summary(out, type = "pc")
#> Call:
#> FSqNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Cohen's f-squared (fsq) and local f-squared
#> type = "pc"
#>            est     se    R   2.5%  97.5%
#> fsq     4.1158 1.6626 5000 2.2408 8.6810
#> NARTIC  0.9510 0.4259 5000 0.3928 2.0567
#> PCTGRT  0.6019 0.3128 5000 0.1868 1.3951
#> PCTSUPP 0.2909 0.2300 5000 0.0430 0.9168
```

### coef


``` r
coef(out)
#>       fsq    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 4.1157764 0.9509843 0.6018924 0.2909455
```

### vcov


``` r
vcov(out)
#>               fsq     NARTIC      PCTGRT     PCTSUPP
#> fsq     2.7643103 0.41122916 0.238364349 0.186533110
#> NARTIC  0.4112292 0.18138466 0.027587957 0.018493839
#> PCTGRT  0.2383643 0.02758796 0.097873970 0.009984946
#> PCTSUPP 0.1865331 0.01849384 0.009984946 0.052901714
```

### confint


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>              2.5 %    97.5 %
#> fsq     2.24080923 8.6810104
#> NARTIC  0.39282353 2.0566974
#> PCTGRT  0.18677794 1.3951305
#> PCTSUPP 0.04304245 0.9168247
```
